AI Overview

AI Mode reply for seo bandwagon

SEO Bandwagon
is a Seattle-based small business SEO agency and software provider founded in 2010. It offers free SEO audit tools, a free Chrome extension, rank tracking, and transparently priced monthly optimization plans starting at $0 up to $249 per month. 
Core Services & Tools
  • Free Tools: Includes an instant site audit, rank tracking for 10 keywords, and a free Chrome extension for grading web pages. 
  • Pro Plan ($99/month): Expanded site audits (10 scans a day) and increased keyword tracking limits for self-managed SEO. 
  • Agentic Local ($249/month per location): Automated AI agents handle monthly technical audits, citation building, and keyword mapping with owner approval workflows. 
  • Human Consulting: Technical audits, WordPress development, and local SEO services backed by a real team in downtown Seattle. 
Company Details
  • Address: 107 Spring St, Suite 404, Seattle, WA 98104
  • Phone: (206) 659-9007 / (866) 535-4SEO
  • Official Website:
